scope: independent root audit of the fixed-M return geometry, uniform two-form sieve, singular-factor average, isolated-row packing, chart aggregation, replay, and ledger interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Repinned the dependencies and replay command to canonical files, including the audited Item 322 report hash. No theorem or numerical constant changed.

mathematical_audit.return_geometry: Solving the fixed-M equations gives p in [(4M+3)/5,(6M-1)/7] and same-ray returns p to p+6k. Degenerate and nondegenerate charts partition this one prime interval and therefore cannot be counted twice.
mathematical_audit.sieve: The Selberg square majorant with z=X^(1/4) yields an absolute uniform upper bound for two linear prime forms. The local correction is exactly the product over q dividing k, q>=5, of (q-1)/(q-2); the z^2 polylog remainder is negligible.
mathematical_audit.singular_average: The squarefree-divisor expansion has nonnegative terms, and summing divisibility over k<=K gives a convergent Euler product times K. Hence complete windows satisfy W_pair << MK/log M.
mathematical_audit.sublog_phase: For K=o(log M), paired endpoint weight is o(M); subtracting it from the prime-number-theorem mass (2/35)M+o(M) leaves the full normalized raw 1/105 ceiling isolated.
mathematical_audit.packing_phase: Within each of the two nonzero residue classes modulo 6, complete-window isolated primes are separated by more than 6K. This gives W_iso << M log M/K+log M and therefore zero isolated rate when K/log M tends to infinity.
mathematical_audit.scope: The critical K comparable to log M regime remains undecided, and no actual carrier implication is proved. The result closes propagation mechanisms requiring a second row only in the stated sublogarithmic or sparse regimes.

PROVED: bounded mean of the singular factor
zero-rate paired support for complete o(log M) windows
